title: Investigation of correlations between personality traits, empathy and emotion recognition - Validation of the German translations of the CASES and the PAQ
summary: This online survey serves to validate the German versions of the Cognitive, Affective, and Somatic Empathy Scales (CASES-G) and the Perth Alexithymia Questionnaire (PAQ) for adolescents and adults. At the beginning, respondents will be informed about the survey procedure, as well as about the inclusion criteria and aspects of data protection. Subsequently, demographic questions and several short questionnaires about personality traits, psychological constructs and behaviors will be answered.

interventions.name: Analysis of questionnaires completed by adolescents and adults. The validity and reliability of the German versions of the Cognitive, Affective, and Somatic Empathy Scales (CASES-G) and the Perth Alexithymia Questionnaire (PAQ) will be examined.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adolescents and adults from the age of 14, sufficient understanding of the German language
Exclusion criteria:
Children and adolescents younger than 14 years
